text:
Nadia: hitting a confusing quickstart failure. Ran `rw cli init && rw sample start` and the app logs "first call failed: permission_denied" even though my token is valid and the org shows up in the console.
Nadia: local curl with the same token returns a 402 Payment Required and JSON `{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"attach a payment method to enable API access"}}` but the CLI surfaces it as permission_denied which is misleading.
Nadia: this tripped up a customer demo ":grimacing:". Can we make the UX clearer?
mika: thanks for the report. Which CLI + sdk versions? we had a mapping bug where some 4xx codes got translated to generic permission errors in the old error shim.
Nadia: rw-cli 0.10.0, redwood-js 0.5.1 under the hood.
onboard-bot: Note: workspace "nadir-playground" trial expired. Billing is required to make API calls beyond trial quota. https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/nadir-playground/billing
Jamie: that explains the 402 body. The mapping bug is realwe changed a few internal errors to be canonical and forgot to special-case billing_required.
Jamie: short-term mitigation: CLI should surface the raw error body when the mapped code is ambiguous. Also adding a preflight `GET /v1/orgs/me/billing_status` on `rw sample start` will let the CLI print a helpful message like "Billing required: visit <link> to enable the API" before the first request.
mika: filing DX ticket RD-4312 to (1) fix error-code mapping in SDK, (2) add a preflight billing check in CLI, (3) add a clearer message for 402 responses.
billing-bot: Automated note: workspace 'nadir-playground' shows trial_expired and no payment method. Follow https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/nadir-playground/billing to add a card.
Nadia: also noticed the CLI retries once before surfacing the error which made the demo look flaky. Can we avoid retries on 402 to prevent duplicate billing attempts or confusing logs?
Jamie: good catch. We'll change retry policy to skip retries for explicit client errors like billing_required and authentication failures.
mika: tagging @product and @docs to update quickstart UX guidelines. For now I added a one-line sentence to the README that `rw sample start` will check billing and show a helpful link if there's an issue.
Nadia: awesome, thanks. Leaving the minimal curl example and CLI logs here: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'` -> returns 402 with billing_required. CLI log excerpt: `[error] first call failed: permission_denied (mapped from 402)`.
Jamie: once RD-4312 lands we'll backport a patch to the stable CLI release so demos stop breaking. Closing this thread once the mapping + preflight PRs merge.
Nadia: thanks all, saved my demo notes here.
